name: Furyou ni Hamerarete Jusei Suru Kyonyuu Okaa-san ~Iki Jigoku ni Ochita Kazoku no Game~
original_name: 不良にハメられて受精する巨乳お母さん ～イキ地獄に堕ちた家族のゲーム～
source:
The town is ruled by delinquents.

As for you and your mother who lived happily and modestly, the delinquent's leader Shin got his eyes on your family.

Your family ties begin to collapse as your cheerful and gentle mother's desire awakes by the cunning tricks of Shin. 

The only thing you can do, is to watch powerless at the figure of your most important person being toyed as a plaything.

Now the game of the family falls into depravity's hell begins.

[Edited from [url=http://www.dmm.co.jp/en/dc/pcgame/-/detail/=/cid=spal_0060/]DMM[/url]]
translation:
这座小镇被不良少年们控制着。

你和母亲原本过着幸福而朴素的生活，不良少年的头目信却盯上了你们一家。

在信的阴谋诡计之下，开朗温柔的母亲被唤醒了欲望，你们一家的羁绊也开始瓦解。

你什么也做不了，只能束手无策地看着自己最重要的人沦为他人肆意玩弄的玩物。

如今，一场将这个家庭拖入堕落地狱的游戏拉开了帷幕。

[改编自[url=http://www.dmm.co.jp/en/dc/pcgame/-/detail/=/cid=spal_0060/]DMM[/url]]
